name: 304 Stainless Steel Frameless Glass Door Pivot Hinge
desc: Clamp-on pivot hinge engineered for frameless glass cabinet and display doors, built from 304 stainless steel with a choice of polished, brushed, black electrophoretic or bright polished finishes. The no-drill clamp design grips the glass edge and locks with hardened self-tapping screws, so existing glass panels can be fitted without boring holes. A soft silicone pad sits between the clamp and the glass to spread load and prevent edge chipping or stress cracks. The dual top-and-bottom pivot structure supports the door at two points, keeping heavier glass leaves vertical and square through thousands of open and close cycles. Three clamp sizes cover 5-8mm, 8-10mm and 10-12mm glass, with side-mount and top-and-bottom variants for different cabinet builds. Hydraulic damped and assist-arm versions are available for quiet, controlled closing. Widely used on wine cabinets, display and showcase units, cupboards, bathroom glass doors and aquarium clamps. Packed as a cross-border ready export item with 48-hour dispatch and a minimum order of a single piece.
specs: Wine Cabinet, Display Cabinet, Bathroom Glass Door
points: No-drill clamp design fits existing glass without boring holes
Soft silicone pads spread load and protect glass edges
Dual top-and-bottom pivots keep heavier door leaves square
Three clamp sizes cover 5-12mm glass thickness
Hydraulic damped variants available for quiet soft closing

name: Anodized Matte Aluminum Arched Bow Cabinet Pull
desc: Solid aluminium cabinet pull with a double-curved arched U profile that gives a full-hand grip instead of the pinch of a thin bar handle. Each pull is cast as one piece from thickened solid aluminium on an integrated base, so the mounting feet resist bending and cracking under daily pull loads. The anodized matte finish is applied in multiple layers and will not oxidise or fade, keeping a consistent appearance across large cabinet runs. Five standard hole spacings of 96mm, 128mm, 160mm, 192mm and 224mm are stocked, with overall lengths from 108mm to 238mm and a uniform 30mm height, so kitchen, wardrobe, bathroom vanity, drawer and shoe cabinet doors can be specified from one family. Installation is a simple three step job: measure the hole spacing, drill the panel and pass the screws through from the back. Matching screw length guidance is provided for 20-40mm panel thickness. Custom sizes, sample-based tooling and OEM packaging are available for furniture manufacturers and importers.
points: Solid one-piece cast base resists bending and cracking
Anodized matte finish will not oxidise or fade
Five standard hole spacings cover most cabinet doors
Arched profile gives a comfortable full-hand grip
Custom sizes, samples and OEM packaging on request

name: Heavy Duty Concealed Window Hinge 90 / 180 Degree
desc: Heavy duty concealed hinge for thermal-break aluminium doors and windows, made from stainless steel and finished by polishing for a clean bright surface. The H-type body sits inside the frame and sash so nothing is visible when the leaf is closed. Four variants are stocked to match different frame profiles and loads: a 4.0mm Euro-groove 90 degree version rated at 40kg, a 5.0mm extended Euro-groove 90 degree version rated at 50kg, a double 4.0mm Euro-groove 180 degree version rated at 50kg, and a screen-window concealed 180 degree version. Body thickness is 4.0mm and the unit is sold by the pair. The hinge fits standard 4.0mm and 5.0mm Euro grooves, so it drops into common PVC and aluminium window systems and suits inward-opening, outward-opening and concealed installation layouts. Applications include heavy thermal-break window and door leaves, cabinet fronts and insect screen panels. Packed as an export-ready supply with a 50 pair minimum order.
points: Carries 40-50kg door leaves on heavy thermal-break frames
Concealed body stays hidden when the leaf is closed
Drops into standard 4.0mm and 5.0mm Euro grooves
Four variants cover 90 and 180 degree opening layouts
Polished stainless steel resists rust in wet climates

name: Solid Rubber Non-Bounce Installation Mallet
desc: Installation mallet built around a three layer shock absorbing structure: an internal steel ball, a one-piece steel frame and a solid oil-resistant rubber head. The head and shaft are formed in a single injection moulding pass, so the rubber wraps the steel core continuously and the head cannot work loose or fly off the way a pressed-on rubber head can. The food-grade oil-resistant rubber striking face is flat and uniform, which spreads impact evenly and protects tiles, laminate flooring, furniture edges and painted surfaces from dents. The head will not deform or go hard with age and copes with oily environments such as kitchen and bathroom fit-outs. A TPR dual-colour over-grip adds a soft anti-slip layer on top of the high-strength solid steel shaft, keeping the mallet secure in gloved or oily hands. Four weight options are available at 1 lb, 1.5 lb, 2 lb and 3 lb, with overall lengths from 320mm to 370mm and net weights from 0.88kg to 1.50kg; the 3 lb model measures 370 x 125 x 60mm at 1.5kg. Aimed at flooring, tiling, furniture assembly and window and door fitting work where a controlled, low-rebound strike is needed.
points: Three-layer build gives high impact with zero bounce
Single over-moulding stops the head working loose
Oil-resistant rubber face will not mark tiles or flooring
TPR over-grip stays secure in oily or gloved hands
Four weights from 1 lb to 3 lb for light to heavy fitting

name: Industrial Grade Carbon Steel Locking Pliers 10-Inch
desc: Industrial grade locking pliers with a round-mouth jaw forged from 45# high carbon structural steel, then high-temperature quenched and finely polished to give very high hardness with strong resistance to wear and deformation. The round jaw and wide opening are paired with an adjustable locking mechanism that self-locks in multiple positions and releases with a single squeeze, so workpieces stay clamped without the operator holding the handles closed. Ideal for woodworking clamping, metal fabrication, assembly, maintenance and DIY tasks where a third hand is needed. Three plain-grip sizes are stocked: 5 inch (140mm), 7 inch (180mm) and 10 inch (225mm), with the 10 inch model weighing 425g. Produced in the Yongkang hand tool cluster with a 2 piece minimum order.
specs: 5 in / 140 mm, 7 in / 180 mm, 10 in / 225 mm
points: 45# steel jaw is quenched for hardness that resists chipping
Multi-position lock clamps tight without hand force
Round wide-opening jaw grips round and irregular work
Quick-release lever opens the jaws in one squeeze

name: Aluminum Rotary Manual Caulking Gun 360 Degree Head
desc: Manual caulking gun built on an aluminium alloy body with an electroplated finish that resists corrosion, oxidation and rust. The push rod is thickened for extra rigidity and steadier pressure, while the handle is reinforced to take repeated high-viscosity loads without flexing. A 360 degree rotating head lets the barrel be indexed to any angle, so corners, ceilings, joints and narrow gaps can be reached without contorting the wrist, and the balanced load path reduces hand fatigue over long sealing sessions. The gun is designed for high-viscosity materials including silicone sealant, structural adhesive and no-nail adhesive, covering bathroom wall sealing, tile and grout finishing, waterproofing and general gap filling. Four variants are supplied: a silver round barrel that takes 590ml sausage packs, blue and orange half-round models, and a yellow double-rail model, each with different dimensions and weights to suit different grip habits. A quality spring and precision pressure plate keep the bead flowing evenly and the return consistent, and every unit is inspected before dispatch.
specs: Silver Round / Blue Half-Round / Orange Half-Round / Yellow Double-Rail
points: 360 degree swivel head reaches corners and tight gaps
Thickened push rod holds steady pressure on thick sealants
Electroplated aluminium body resists rust and oxidation
Four frame variants match different cartridge formats
Quality spring and pressure plate give a smooth even bead

name: 24V Cordless Electric Grease Gun Brushless 2200mAh
desc: Cordless electric grease gun powered by an all-copper brushless motor driving a three-stage planetary gear reduction unit, rated at 24V with three selectable speed settings. The brushless design cuts sparking and brush wear for longer service life and stronger sustained output, and the geared head builds pressure quickly for fast grease delivery on excavators, trucks and plant equipment. A 2200mAh lithium battery is supplied, and selected models offer a rotary gun body that swings through 45 degrees and 180 degrees, letting the operator reach fittings at awkward angles without wrestling the hose. The barrel is stainless steel for rust and wear resistance. An automatic dispensing switch lock keeps grease flowing without holding the trigger, and a high-brightness LED illuminates the work area for night or low-light servicing. The gun accepts both grease cartridges and bulk fill, and is available as an upright model, a rotary model or a brushless pistol-grip model. Three supply configurations are offered, from the bare tool through to a two-battery kit with charger, so buyers can match the package to their usage frequency and budget.
points: Brushless motor with planetary gears builds pressure fast
Continuous dispensing switch lock saves hand effort
Rotary body reaches fittings at 45 and 180 degrees
Stainless barrel and LED suit outdoor service work
Bare-tool to two-battery kits match any budget

name: 21V Brushless Right Angle Ratchet Wrench Kit
desc: Cordless brushless right-angle ratchet wrench on a 21V lithium platform, built for stage truss assembly and light steel structure fastening where space is tight and the fastener sits at an awkward angle. The 90 degree right-angle head reaches bolts that a straight-bodied tool cannot address and reduces wrist strain in overhead or vertical work. The brushless motor delivers a high impact frequency of 3,500 per minute with a torque output in the 320 N.cm class, giving the mix of speed and control needed for repetitive light and medium fastening. Operation features include forward and reverse adjustment, a safety switch to prevent accidental starts, a battery level display, stepless variable speed control and a quick-load chuck for fast bit changes. The wrench is supplied as a cased kit with accessories, and is produced in the Nantong power tool cluster.
points: 90 degree head reaches fasteners a straight body cannot
3,500 impacts per minute speeds up truss and rack assembly
Brushless motor runs cooler with less maintenance
Forward/reverse, safety switch and battery display built in
Supplied as a cased kit with accessories ready to work

name: Pneumatic Caulking Gun 310 / 400 / 600 ml with Regulator
desc: All-metal pneumatic caulking gun for professional sealing work, running on 3-6 kg of shop air. The body uses aluminium front and rear covers, an aluminium tube and a screw-fixed metal clamp that can be stripped down for maintenance. Two physically distinct product lines cover the main adhesive formats: hard-glue models such as UM-220 and UM-230 use air-pressure direct push with a spring plate and no piston for 310ml plastic cartridges, while soft-glue models such as UM-300 and UM-460 use a split rubber piston with a safety cord for sausage packs, sealing tightly and preventing the piston from popping out. Barrel capacity runs to 310ml, 400ml and 600ml, with a tube inner diameter of about 50mm and sausage length limits of 25cm at 400ml and 35cm at 600ml. Net weight is 0.85kg on the 310ml hard-glue model and 1.0kg on the 600ml soft-glue model. An adjustable barometer controls output: lift the knob and turn left to reduce or right to increase pressure. Releasing the trigger opens a quick exhaust port that stops the bead instantly without drips, and the rubber air hose resists wear and corrosion. The ergonomic non-slip handle and threaded front cover keep long single-handed sessions comfortable and leak free. Suited to sheet metal, window and door installation, curtain wall sealing, automotive repair and general construction jointing with silicone, structural and silicone sealants.
specs: Aluminum Alloy Front / Rear Cover and Tube
Adjustable Pressure Gauge + Trigger Quick Exhaust
Windows, Curtain Wall, Sheet Metal, Auto Repair
points: Adjustable regulator dials bead speed precisely
Trigger quick exhaust stops the bead with no drips

name: Pneumatic Paint Mixer 10-30L Explosion-Proof
desc: Air-driven mixer for small batches of 10-30L, equivalent to the 5 US gallon class, aimed at laboratory trials, formulation work and small production runs. Because the motor runs on compressed air rather than electricity there is no spark risk, so the unit is intrinsically safe and explosion-proof in flammable or explosive liquid environments. Stepless free speed regulation lets the operator tune agitation to suit thin solvents or heavy coatings without changing tools. Fifteen configurations are available across clamp-mounted, platform, manual lift, horizontal, pneumatic lift, bare-unit, laboratory with clamp, and hand-held pistol types, in either stainless steel or aluminium series, so the mixer can be matched to cleanroom, corrosion resistance or light weight priorities. Applications span chemical processing, pharmaceuticals, food and daily chemical production, printing and ink, and adhesive and coating lines. Supplied factory direct with no third-party contract manufacturing, with custom drum sizes supported on request and a minimum order of one unit.

Factory Direct, Custom Drum Sizes on Request
